Sites.Name: fishing weir
Sites.Broken: The weir's stakes have rotted at the waterline; the perch go round it.

Lasting.Text: You cut out the rotten stakes, drive new ones and work the timber in between. The current leans on it, and the weir holds.

Patch.Text: You wedge a plank across the worst gap. It will hold for a while.

Sites.Relapse: The weir at Tine has gapped again while you were away; the perch are going round it.

Sites.Name: guest-cloth
Sites.Broken: The cloth on the guest pole is torn through. A guest cannot sit under it.

Lasting.Text: You hang a new cloth from the pole and peg it square. There is shade under it again.

Sites.Relapse: The guest-cloth at Gantry has come down again.

Sites.Name: pan scales
Sites.Broken: The counterweight is cracked through and the salt pan sits low on its beam.

Lasting.Text: You pin the cracked counterweight with iron, bind the beam, and hang the pan again. Empty, it rides level. A weighed stone reads true twice running.

Patch.Text: You pour sand into the low pan until the beam rides level. It will hold until the wind gets at it.

Sites.Relapse: The sand has blown out of the pan at Wellmeet. The scales sit low again.

Sites.Name: survey line
Sites.Broken: The survey stakes lean out of line, and the cord between them hangs slack across the wrong bodies.

Lasting.Text: You drive oak down past the soft peat into the firm, and re-run the cord stake to stake. The line stands straight from the first number to the last.

Patch.Text: You set willow where the worst stakes walked. It is straight today.

Sites.Relapse: The willow stakes at the Drowned Ledger have bent with the peat. The line is out again.

Sites.Name: mine pump
Sites.Broken: The pump's rod has sheared at the collar, and the old binding hangs in black strings. Water stands in the shaft below.

Lasting.Text: You pin a new oak rod with iron at the collar and bind it tight. The pump takes its first stroke, coughs up black water, and keeps going.

Patch.Text: You pack clay round the sheared collar. It turns, for now.

Sites.Relapse: The clay round Cinderhold's pump collar has cracked through. The water is climbing in the lower level again.
